_about: Hand-written theses, merged into each company at page load. Format (approved Nov 25 2026): th_view = call + one fact with a number; th_miss = what the market misses (implied vs our odds/sales + evidence-based reason); th_cat = dated catalyst + the result that would change our mind. ceo_notes: 0-3 company-specific notes, cat in money/message/moves/miles. Tokens rendered live: {cap} {cash} {px} {imp} {ours} {mktsales} {oursales}. Batch 1 = 40 priority longs/shorts, written Nov 25 2026 from the record (efficacy, catalysts, cash, call reasons). Batch 2 = 102 remaining STRONG BUY / STRONG SHORT / SHORT names (view + catalyst; misses computed unless written), Nov 25 2026.

COLL.th_view: Long: a cash-generative specialty pharma on ~$865M of 2026 sales (FY guide $825-855M reaffirmed), with JORNAY PM growing 24% while the pain portfolio shrinks 18%.
COLL.th_miss: The market treats Collegium as a melting pain business carrying $1.08B of debt. At a {cap} cap plus net debt, the enterprise value is about 2x sales, and JORNAY PM plus AZSTARYS are becoming the larger profit pool as debt is paid down.
COLL.th_cat: FY26 results and 2027 guidance (Feb 2027). We are wrong if 2027 guidance shows total revenue falling faster than the ADHD growth, or if cash goes to an expensive acquisition instead of debt paydown.

ceo_notes.t: With debt of $1.08B against a {cap} cap, every dollar of free cash flow that goes to paydown accrues to equity. A stated leverage target and timetable would do more for the stock than another buyback.
Report ADHD (JORNAY PM + AZSTARYS) and pain as separate segments with their own growth and margin, so investors value the growing part on its own instead of the blended +3%.

BEAM.th_view: Long: two base-editing assets with human data. BEAM-302 lifted total AAT to 12.4 µM at 60 mg in 29 AATD patients, above the 11 µM protective level, and risto-cel is on track for a sickle-cell BLA as early as YE2026.
BEAM.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds for BEAM-302; we use {ours} because a one-time edit that clears the protective AAT threshold and cuts toxic Z-AAT up to 78% treats both lung and liver disease, and risto-cel adds a second near-term asset.
BEAM.th_cat: Risto-cel updated data and BLA submission (by YE2026); BEAM-302 pivotal dosing complete 1H27. We would cut if the BLA slips into 2027 without a reason, or if longer follow-up shows AAT falling back below 11 µM.

ceo_notes.t: The market still values Beam on BEAM-302 alone. Give risto-cel its own launch plan, price and patient numbers at BLA filing so investors can value the second asset.
With ~9.6 quarters of cash, raising on the risto-cel BLA acceptance rather than before it would be the cheaper capital.

MLYS.th_view: Long into the Dec 22 PDUFA: lorundrostat has two positive pivotals (placebo-adjusted SBP −9.1 mmHg in Launch-HTN, −7.9 mmHg in Advance-HTN) on top of background therapy.
MLYS.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the price implies ~{imp} odds of reaching a $2.8B peak; we use {ours}. The debate is not approval but uptake as the #2 aldosterone synthase inhibitor behind AstraZeneca's baxdrostat, and we think a large resistant-hypertension market fits two drugs.
MLYS.th_cat: FDA decision Dec 22 2026. We are wrong on the long if the label carries a hyperkalemia restriction tighter than baxdrostat's or if payers require step-through after MRAs.

ceo_notes.t: As the second drug in class, a commercial partner with primary-care reach would launch faster than a standalone sales force; settle that before the PDUFA, not after.

NKTR.th_view: Long: REZPEG hit its Ph2b in atopic dermatitis (n=393, p<0.001, Lancet) with durable responses on maintenance dosing, and the Treg mechanism aims at durable control rather than suppression.
NKTR.th_miss: At {cap} against {cash} of cash, the market pays almost nothing for REZPEG (~{imp} implied odds); we use {ours} because a positive randomized Ph2b plus a second indication (alopecia areata) is worth more than the cash.
NKTR.th_cat: ZENITH alopecia areata Ph3 start (Dec 2026); AD Ph3 topline mid-2028. Our view changes if Ph3 maintenance data show responses fading off-drug, which would make REZPEG just another injectable.

ceo_notes.t: The stock trades near cash with Ph3 topline in mid-2028; a partner for ex-US rights or for alopecia would fund the program without dilution at today's price.

LEGN.th_view: Long: Carvykti is the best-selling myeloma CAR-T (Q2 net trade sales $657M, ~$2.6B annualized) with a PFS hazard ratio of 0.26 in CARTITUDE-4.
LEGN.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales against a ~$2.6B run rate. It is pricing the 2026 problems (CEO exit, the raise at $29.35 that broke, J&J clawing back funding advances), not the franchise, which still grows and has CARTITUDE-5/6 in newly diagnosed disease.
LEGN.th_cat: Quarterly Carvykti sales and J&J repayment schedule. We are wrong if sales stall below a $700M quarter or if repayments to J&J consume the cash before profitability.

ceo_notes.t: Name a permanent CEO and publish the J&J repayment schedule; the discount is about governance and cash claims, not the drug.
After a raise that traded 35% below its price within six weeks, avoid new equity until profitability is visible in reported numbers.

ACHV.th_view: Long: cytisinicline's June CRL was manufacturing and labeling only. The clinical package is intact: ORCA-2 abstinence 32.6% vs 7.0% at weeks 9-12, and 31.2% quit at one year.
ACHV.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because a CMC-only CRL with the manufacturing transfer largely complete is a timing problem, not a data problem.
ACHV.th_cat: NDA resubmission (Q4 2026), then an FDA decision in 1H27. We would change our view if FDA classifies the resubmission as Class 2 with a new inspection finding, or asks for clinical work.

ceo_notes.t: Confirm the resubmission date and its class the day it goes in; until then investors discount a slip.
Smoking cessation needs primary-care reach. Line up a commercial partner before approval so the launch does not depend on a raise.

ANAB.th_view: Long: a pure Jemperli royalty. Jemperli net sales reached $365M (+20%) and rectal cancer was added in October; RUBY showed an overall-survival HR of 0.69 in first-line endometrial cancer.
ANAB.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of royalty-bearing sales; GSK guides Jemperli to more than $2.7B at peak. The discount is the Tesaro lawsuit seeking to halve the royalty, which we think is priced as if Tesaro wins.
ANAB.th_cat: Tesaro litigation ruling (Q4 2026 to Q1 2027) and imsidolimab PDUFA Dec 12 2026. We are wrong if the court cuts the royalty rate, which would remove most of the upside.

ceo_notes.t: With $257M of debt against $164M of cash, use the royalty stream to retire debt or buy back stock once the litigation is resolved, not to rebuild a pipeline.

HRMY.th_view: Long: WAKIX grew 30% to a record ~$261M in Q2, and cash of {cash} covers a large part of the {cap} cap.
HRMY.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales against a $1.1B run rate. It prices WAKIX as if orexin agonists end the franchise; we think pitolisant GR (PDUFA Apr 1 2027) and the pediatric label extend it, and TEMPO in Prader-Willi is free optionality.
HRMY.th_cat: AET ANDA injunction hearing Jan 26 2027; pitolisant GR PDUFA Apr 1 2027. We are wrong if generic entry is allowed before 2030 or if orexin-agonist launch data show fast switching from WAKIX.

ceo_notes.t: With {cash} of cash and orexin agonists coming, buying a second commercial-stage sleep or rare-neurology asset now, while WAKIX funds it, is the move investors would reward.

MLTX.th_view: Long: sonelokimab showed 67-69% HiSCR75 at week 52 in hidradenitis suppurativa (VELA-1/2), against ~50% for bimekizumab, and the HS BLA went in on Sep 30.
MLTX.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $2.2B peak; we use {ours}. The market is weighing the single VELA-2 miss and the lack of a head-to-head trial; the pooled week-52 durability is the better guide to how doctors will use it.
MLTX.th_cat: FDA acceptance and PDUFA date for the HS BLA (around Nov-Dec 2026). We would change our mind on a refuse-to-file or a standard review with an advisory committee focused on VELA-2.

ceo_notes.t: Show the week-52 data against bimekizumab's on the same as-observed basis; investors will not credit the durability claim without a like-for-like table.

OCUL.th_view: Long: AXPAXLI beat aflibercept on maintained vision in SOL-1 (74.1% vs 65.9%, p=0.0006), the first superiority win over an approved anti-VEGF in wet AMD.
OCUL.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $3.6B peak; we use {ours} because a superiority result with FDA alignment on the filing is rarer than the price suggests.
OCUL.th_cat: NDA submission (Q4 2026). Our view changes if the filing slips or FDA requires SOL-R (2028) before approval.

ceo_notes.t: With ~8 quarters of cash and an NDA going in, raise on FDA acceptance rather than before it.

LYEL.th_view: Long: ronde-cel (CD19/CD20 CAR-T) delivered 91% ORR and 77% CR in 3L+ large B-cell lymphoma, with 75% of complete responses still in CR at 12 months and lower severe toxicity than approved CAR-Ts.
LYEL.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds for ronde-cel; we use {ours} because response and durability already meet the approved-product bar and the safety profile supports outpatient use, which the crowded-field discount ignores.
LYEL.th_cat: ASH oral with 80+ patients (Dec 12-15 2026). We would cut if the 12-month CR rate falls below ~60% in the larger cohort or severe ICANS rises above 10%.

ceo_notes.t: With ~5.4 quarters of cash, raise after the ASH data if they hold; a raise before a pivotal readout in mid-2027 would be priced off today's discount.

APMD.th_view: Long: AD109 could be the first oral drug for obstructive sleep apnea; two Ph3s cut AHI 55.6% vs 19.1% (SynAIRgy) and 46.8% vs 6.8% (LunAIRo), with a PDUFA on Feb 28 2027.
APMD.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $4.0B peak; we use {ours}. The stock is priced as if dry mouth and insomnia will keep patients off it, but CPAP's poor adherence leaves a very large group with no tolerable option.
APMD.th_cat: FDA decision Feb 28 2027. We would cut on a CRL, or on a label limited to CPAP-intolerant patients with a strong warning on cardiovascular effects.

ceo_notes.t: OSA is a primary-care and sleep-clinic market; a partner with that reach, or a co-promote, would de-risk the launch more than a standalone build.

SANA.th_view: Short: the 14-month islet result that drives the stock is one patient given donor cells (UP421), not SC451, which has no human data.
SANA.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds that SC451 reaches a $2.5B peak; we use {ours}. One donor-islet patient shows hypoimmune editing can work, but says little about a stem-cell product that has not been dosed, and Vertex is years ahead.
SANA.th_cat: SC451 IND clearance and Ph1 start (guided as early as 2026). We would turn more positive if SC451 itself shows C-peptide production without immunosuppression in its first patients.

ceo_notes.t: With ~3.4 quarters of cash, raise now while the UP421 result supports the price; waiting for SC451 data risks a raise from a weaker position.

CTY.th_view: Short: a {cap} company whose lead has only healthy-volunteer data (85% FXI knockdown after one 150 mg dose) and no bleeding or clotting endpoints.
CTY.th_miss: At {cap}, the price exceeds what certain success on CITY-FXI would be worth; we use {ours} odds. Factor XI already has three Ph3 programs from Bayer, BMS/J&J and Novartis/Anthos, so knockdown alone does not differentiate.
CTY.th_cat: ASH oral Dec 12 2026, then TKA Ph2 design. We would cover if the data show dosing twice a year or less with clean bleeding, which would give a real point of difference.

ceo_notes.t: With ~4.7 quarters of cash and a post-IPO valuation, a follow-on after ASH would be cheap capital; do not wait for Ph2.

ABSI.th_view: Short: ABS-201 has safety and a ~65-day half-life from 32 healthy adults, and no efficacy data, yet the company trades at {cap}.
ABSI.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds that ABS-201 reaches a $1.8B peak; we use {ours}. Hair loss is crowded (generic finasteride and minoxidil, oral minoxidil, newer topicals), and the AI-design premium has not yet produced a validated drug.
ABSI.th_cat: 13-week AGA interim (Dec 2026). We would cover if hair-count gain beats placebo by 20% or more, the level that justifies Ph3.

ceo_notes.t: State the hair-count bar for the December interim in advance; a pre-set threshold protects the stock if the result is good and limits the damage if it is not.

SRZN.th_view: Short: SZN-8141 has dosed its first DME patient and has no efficacy data, while four retinal competitors are in late-stage trials.
SRZN.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds that SZN-8141 reaches a $1.0B peak; we use {ours}. Wnt modulation is unproven in the retina, and by its 2H27 Ph1b readout AXPAXLI, 4D-150 and others may have reset the bar.
SRZN.th_cat: DUET Ph1b topline (2H 2027). We would cover if early patients show vision or fluid gains beyond anti-VEGF alone.

SEPN.th_view: Short: SEP-479, an oral PTH1R agonist, is in healthy-volunteer Ph1, yet the stock rose ~70% in a year to a {cap} cap.
SEPN.th_miss: At {cap}, the price is more than certain success on SEP-479 would justify; we use {ours} odds. The first candidate was dropped, and a same-mechanism program (EVO756) missed its Ph2b in June, so the read-through risk is not priced.
SEPN.th_cat: SEP-479 SAD/MAD data (Q1 2027). We would cover if Ph1 shows dose-dependent calcium increases with a once-daily oral profile.

ceo_notes.t: With {cash} of cash and a 70% run, the valuation is currency: a partnership or in-licensing deal now is cheaper than after Ph1 data.

KYMR.th_view: Watch after the win: BROADEN2 (244 patients) showed EASI −72% vs −27% and vIGA 0/1 38% vs 11% at the mid dose, dupilumab-class efficacy from a once-daily pill.
KYMR.th_miss: At {cap} the market already pays for more than a $5.4B atopic dermatitis peak; we moved our odds to {ours}. After a 49% move the stock prices a Phase 3 win plus asthma and other type 2 diseases, so the asymmetry has gone.
KYMR.th_cat: Phase 3 start in AD (by mid-2027); BREADTH asthma Ph2b (late 2027). We would turn long on a pullback that prices only AD, or short if Phase 3 dose selection reveals a safety signal (conjunctivitis above dupilumab's rate). The $1.5B offering (Nov 23) removes the funding question.

ceo_notes.t: You launched a $1.5B offering the day after the data, at the best price Kymera may see before Phase 3. Use it to fund Phase 3 in AD and asthma in full so there is no second raise before data.
Big pharma will want an oral STAT6 asset; decide whether to partner ex-US now, while the data are fresh, or keep full rights through Phase 3.

TARS.th_view: Long: XDEMVY sold $194.6M in Q3 (+64% year on year, >$1B cumulative) as the only approved Demodex blepharitis treatment.
TARS.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of XDEMVY sales; we model {oursales}. Eye-care launches usually slow after year two, but XDEMVY is still growing over 60% with no direct competitor.
TARS.th_cat: Q4 sales (Feb 2027); TP-04 ocular rosacea and TP-05 Lyme prevention Ph2 toplines (1H 2027). We would cut if quarterly growth falls below 30% or a copay-practices inquiry hits net price.

ceo_notes.t: Disclose new-to-brand prescriptions and refill rates; investors need to see whether growth comes from new patients or repeat use before paying for a $5B peak.

OCS.th_view: Long, with low conviction: after OCS-01 failed in DME, privosegtor has Breakthrough designation and Ph2 signals in acute optic neuritis (+18 letters of low-contrast acuity, lower NfL and GFAP).
OCS.th_miss: At {cap}, of which {cash} is cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds for privosegtor; we use {ours}. The evidence is thin (Ph2, biomarkers and one visual measure), but no neuroprotectant is approved for optic neuropathies.
OCS.th_cat: R&D Day Dec 8 2026; licaminlimab PREDICT-1 topline (YE2026). We would cut to Hold if the R&D Day shows no Ph3 design agreed with FDA for privosegtor.

ceo_notes.t: After the DME miss, investors need an FDA-agreed registrational design for privosegtor; put the endpoint and size on the table at the Dec 8 R&D Day.

CELC.th_view: Long: REVTORPYK launched Sep 30 after cutting progression or death by 76% (HR ~0.24) in PIK3CA wild-type HR+/HER2- breast cancer, with no direct wild-type competitor.
CELC.th_miss: At {cap} (with $754M of debt against {cash} of cash) the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales; management targets a $2.5-3B peak. The PIK3CA-mutant sNDA (PDUFA Jun 25 2027) would roughly double the eligible population.
CELC.th_cat: First full quarter of sales (Q4 results); mutant sNDA PDUFA Jun 25 2027. We would cut if early sales show tolerability (hyperglycemia, stomatitis) limiting use, or the mutant label goes to inavolisib-first.

ceo_notes.t: Report new patient starts and duration on therapy from the first quarter; the market's question is tolerability in practice, and early data answer it.

SLS.th_view: Short on valuation: REGAL hit overall survival (24.0 vs 14.7 months, HR 0.59, p=0.035, n=126), but the company is worth {cap} for a drug we see peaking at ~$500M.
SLS.th_miss: At {cap} the price exceeds what certain approval of GPS would be worth; we use {ours} odds. A single 126-patient trial with p=0.035 in a small AML maintenance niche leaves room for FDA questions, and the cap prices a much larger market.
SLS.th_cat: FDA meeting on the filing strategy (1H 2027). We would cover if FDA agrees REGAL alone supports a BLA and the company shows a path to larger AML settings.

ceo_notes.t: The stock is valued far above the drug's near-term sales; the proposed $150M offering should be upsized while that holds.

XNCR.th_view: Short: XmAb819 showed 45.5% confirmed ORR in only 11 RCC patients with 72% grade 3+ related side effects, behind Merck's 52.6%, and registration work starts only by end-2027.
XNCR.th_miss: At {cap}, more than certain success on XmAb819 would justify; we use {ours} odds. The platform royalties are smaller than modelled after the Alexion settlement ended US Ultomiris royalties, so the premium has less behind it.
XNCR.th_cat: XmAb819 subcutaneous data and FDA engagement (1H 2027). We would cover if SC dosing brings grade 3+ side effects below ~40% while holding response near 45%.

ceo_notes.t: The platform has not produced a wholly owned winner; out-licensing XmAb819 and focusing spend would extend cash past the next data.

LYCA.th_view: Short: a {cap} post-IPO valuation rests on one cohort of ~8 healthy atopic volunteers whose free IgE fell 96%.
LYCA.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds that LCA-0061 reaches a $1.8B peak; we use {ours}. Xolair already removes IgE, so deeper depletion must show better clinical results, and no patient data exist; the lock-up expiry adds supply.
LYCA.th_cat: Ph1 data in elevated-IgE and food-allergy patients (2027). We would cover if patients show larger and longer IgE suppression than omalizumab with a clinical signal.

TSHA.th_view: Long: TSHA-102 is the only Rett syndrome gene therapy with a self-regulating MECP2 construct; all 12 Part A patients gained or regained at least one milestone by 12 months, with no dose-limiting toxicity.
TSHA.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because 100% milestone response against a ~7% natural-history rate is a large effect, and REVEAL Part B is fully dosed (17 patients).
TSHA.th_cat: REVEAL Part B 6-month interim and FDA feedback on the BLA path (1H 2027). We would cut if fewer than half of Part B patients gain a milestone or a liver or MECP2-overexpression signal appears.

ceo_notes.t: Neurogene is ahead on enrollment; publish the milestone definitions and natural-history comparator now so the interim is judged on your terms.

PGEN.th_view: Long: Papzimeos is the first approved therapy for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (51% surgery-free at 12 months) and turned profitable in Q3 ($35.8M net income on $72.9M revenue).
PGEN.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales against a $292M run rate after two quarters. With no competitor and a +37% quarter-on-quarter ramp, we think the launch has further to go.
PGEN.th_cat: Q4 sales and EMA review outcome (2027). We would cut if quarterly revenue stalls, which would suggest the prevalent patient pool is smaller than modelled.

ceo_notes.t: Cash is only $51M against $100M of debt; use launch profits to build a buffer before spending on the AdenoVerse pipeline.

NTLA.th_view: Long: lonvo-z met all HAELO endpoints (NEJM), with most patients attack-free and off treatment after one 50 mg dose; priority review sets a Mar 10 2027 PDUFA with no advisory committee.
NTLA.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $4.0B peak; we use {ours}. The stock trades on launch-funding fears, but a one-time cure in a disease treated with lifelong injectables (Takhzyro, ~87% attack reduction) should take share fast.
NTLA.th_cat: FDA decision Mar 10 2027. We would cut on a CRL or a label requiring long-term follow-up that slows uptake.

ceo_notes.t: With ~6 quarters of cash and a launch ahead, raise on approval, or sign royalty financing now, rather than letting the cash runway set the price.

AMPH.th_view: Avoid: BAQSIMI, the growth driver, faces rebate and 340B price erosion and competition from Lilly and Xeris, and Amphastar carries $613M of debt with an open FDA warning letter.
AMPH.th_miss: The market prices Amphastar as a stable generics company with a growing branded product. Q3 BAQSIMI grew 10%, but earlier in 2026 net revenue fell 15% on price while units rose, and generic injectables face steady price decline.
AMPH.th_cat: FY26 results and 2027 guidance (Feb-Mar 2027). We would turn positive if the warning letter is closed and BAQSIMI net price stabilizes for two quarters.

ceo_notes.t: Give BAQSIMI net price and volume separately each quarter; mixing them hides whether 340B erosion has stopped.

GPCR.th_view: Long: aleniglipron gave 16.3% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 44 weeks with no plateau and 2-3% discontinuation for side effects, and {cash} of cash is about the whole {cap} cap.
GPCR.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $3.0B peak; we use {ours}. An oral small molecule at orforglipron's level or better is valuable to every company without one, and the stock prices it at roughly zero.
GPCR.th_cat: Q4 2026 toplines (44-week body composition, 30-week T2D, SWITCH). We would cut if the T2D study shows weaker HbA1c than orforglipron or liver-enzyme signals.

ceo_notes.t: With cash covering the cap, the fastest way to show the value is a partnership: big pharma without an oral GLP-1 should be competing for aleniglipron now.

ARDX.th_view: Long: IBSRELA grew 23% to $96.3M in Q3 and Ardelyx sells two approved drugs at a {cap} cap, ~1.6x annualized revenue.
ARDX.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales against a $502M run rate. It is pricing the FY26 guidance cut ($350-370M) as permanent payer friction; IBSRELA's prescription growth suggests access will improve.
ARDX.th_cat: 2027 IBSRELA guidance (Feb 2027); ACCEL Ph3 in chronic idiopathic constipation (2H 2027). We would cut if 2027 guidance implies under 15% growth.

ceo_notes.t: Explain the guidance cut by payer and channel, with the date each contract renews; the market assumes the worst when it cannot see the timeline.

FDMT.th_view: Long: 4D-150, a one-time intravitreal gene therapy, cut aflibercept injections 78% over two years in PRISM (n=45), and both Ph3s are fully enrolled.
FDMT.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds of a $3.8B peak; we use {ours} because two-year durability is already shown and the Ph3 bar is non-inferior vision with fewer injections.
FDMT.th_cat: 4FRONT-1 Ph3 topline vs aflibercept (Q2 2027). We would cut if vision is not non-inferior or inflammation needs chronic steroids.

ceo_notes.t: With ~6.7 quarters of cash, a raise before 4FRONT-1 is likely; size it to reach the readout and tie it to the enrollment news so it does not look forced.

ANNX.th_view: Long: tanruprubart is the first drug to beat placebo in Guillain-Barré syndrome with one infusion (Ph3, n=241), where no drug is approved.
ANNX.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because the EU review is under way and the effect is visible from week 1. The discount reflects the unfiled US BLA and short cash runway, not the data.
ANNX.th_cat: US BLA submission (guided Q4 2026). We would cut if the filing slips into 2027 or FDA asks for a second trial.

ceo_notes.t: With ~4.4 quarters of cash, file the BLA and raise on acceptance; a raise before filing would be priced off the delay.
Give a firm BLA date; missing the earlier guidance is why the market discounts the program.

HELP.th_view: Long: APPROACH (n=222) hit with MADRS −7.6 vs placebo at week 6 and remission 50.9% vs 18.2%, and the stock fell 21% on the day.
HELP.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours}. The sell-off priced three treatment-related serious side effects and the need for a second trial, but the effect size beats most adjunctive depression drugs.
HELP.th_cat: EMBRACE second pivotal topline (4Q 2027). We would cut if EMBRACE shows less than half APPROACH's effect or more serious psychiatric events.

ceo_notes.t: With ~4.8 quarters of cash and EMBRACE a year away, raise now on the positive Ph3 rather than into the next binary.
Detail the three treatment-related serious events and the monitoring plan; the stock fell on the uncertainty, not the efficacy.

GERN.th_view: Long, valuation only: with myelofibrosis gone (IMpactMF stopped Oct 28), RYTELO grew to $60.1M in Q3 (+27%) and Geron is now profitable.
GERN.th_miss: At {cap}, with {cash} of cash and $122M of debt, the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of RYTELO sales against a $240M run rate. It values the company as if RYTELO is shrinking; we model {oursales}.
GERN.th_cat: Germany launch (YE2026) and 2027 guidance. We would exit if quarterly sales fall, which would mean luspatercept is taking the LR-MDS market.

ceo_notes.t: Without myelofibrosis, Geron is a single-product company; cut R&D to keep it profitable and return or preserve cash rather than start a new program.

GYRE.th_view: Long: hydronidone showed fibrosis regression in a China Ph3 in hepatitis B liver fibrosis and is under NMPA priority review, with no approved competitor.
GYRE.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because priority review and a met Ph3 endpoint usually lead to approval in China. The market discounts China-only value and the 69.7% ownership of the operating subsidiary.
GYRE.th_cat: China NDA decision (expected by YE2026 to 1H 2027). We would cut on a request for more data or a narrow conditional label.

ceo_notes.t: US investors discount China-only assets; show pricing, reimbursement timing and the share of profits that reaches Gyre shareholders.

ZVRA.th_view: Long: MIPLYFFA is the only approved Niemann-Pick type C drug ($34.0M in Q3), and cash of {cash} is about half the {cap} cap.
ZVRA.th_miss: At {cap} the market pays for ~{mktsales}/yr of sales against a $151M run rate. It reads the flat sequential quarters as a peak; the infant sNDA and celiprolol in vascular EDS add patients it does not price.
ZVRA.th_cat: Infant (<24 months) sNDA filing (Q1 2027). We would cut if MIPLYFFA revenue declines for two more quarters.

ceo_notes.t: Report patients on therapy and discontinuations; flat revenue with growing patients is a pricing story, with falling patients it is a demand story, and investors cannot tell which.

ALMS.th_view: Long: envudeucitinib hit two Ph3s in psoriasis (PASI90 68.0% and 62.1% at week 24, beating apremilast), with an NDA due Q4 2026.
ALMS.th_miss: At {cap}, with {cash} of cash, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours}. The 57% fall on the lupus miss removed optionality, but the psoriasis data (PASI75 ~74% vs ~58% for Sotyktu, cross-trial) are untouched.
ALMS.th_cat: NDA submission (Q4 2026). We would cut if the NDA slips or a commercial partner does not emerge before approval.

ceo_notes.t: As the second oral TYK2, a commercial partner with dermatology reach is worth more than a standalone launch; that deal is the next re-rating event.

RGNX.th_view: Long: RGX-202 met its Duchenne pivotal endpoint, with 93% of patients above 10% micro-dystrophin (p<0.0001) and functional gains; BLA due Q1 2027.
RGNX.th_miss: At {cap} with {cash} of cash and $186M of debt, the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours}. The ELEVIDYS safety history weighs on the whole class, but RGX-202's construct and expression are differentiated and the accelerated-approval bar is met.
RGNX.th_cat: Pre-BLA meeting (Q4 2026), BLA submission (Q1 2027); sura-vec wet AMD pivotal topline (Q4 2026). We would cut if FDA rejects external-control functional data or a liver-safety signal appears.

ceo_notes.t: Publish the full liver-safety data next to ELEVIDYS's; class safety is the discount, and only your own data can separate you from it.

ARVN.th_view: Long, as a cash shell with options: the company trades below its {cash} of cash with no debt, and owns ARV-102, a brain-penetrant LRRK2 degrader with >50% CSF knockdown for 28 days.
ARVN.th_miss: At {cap}, below cash, the market gives ARV-102 and the half-share of vepdegestrant royalties (via Rigel) no value. Our {ours} odds are low, but the downside is limited by the cash.
ARVN.th_cat: ARV-393 data at ASH (Dec 12-15 2026); ARV-102 Ph1 progression. We would exit if the cash is spent on a broad early pipeline without returning capital.

ceo_notes.t: The market values the company below cash; a buyback or a special dividend, with ARV-102 funded through Ph1 only, is the move holders would reward.

RZLT.th_view: Short: after the congenital-HI Ph3 missed, the stock depends on upLIFT, a 16-patient open-label study in tumor hyperinsulinism that reads in mid-December.
RZLT.th_miss: At {cap} the price exceeds what certain success in a market we size at ~$18M peak would be worth; we use {ours} odds. Interim responders (7 of 8) look good, but the indication is tiny.
RZLT.th_cat: upLIFT topline (mid-Dec 2026). We would cover if the company shows a path back to congenital HI or a larger indication; a clean upLIFT alone does not justify the cap.

ceo_notes.t: With ~5 quarters of cash, raise immediately after a positive upLIFT; it is the last clear catalyst before a long gap.

ROIV.th_view: Short on valuation: the company is worth {cap} against {cash} of cash, with LISRAYA newly launched in dermatomyositis and Immunovant's Graves' and MG readouts not until 2027.
ROIV.th_cat: IMVT-1402 Graves' and MG registrational readouts (2027). We would cover if IMVT-1402 shows euthyroid rates near batoclimab's ~76% with a clean lipid and albumin profile.

SMMT.th_view: Short: FDA rejected ivonescimab in EGFR-mutant NSCLC (Nov 13 CRL) because HARMONi missed overall survival (HR 0.79, not significant), yet the company is still worth {cap}.
SMMT.th_cat: HARMONi-3 first-line NSCLC final PFS (squamous cohort) and OS data. We would cover if HARMONi-3 shows a significant survival benefit in a Western-weighted population.

TGTX.th_view: Short: BRIUMVI guidance is ~$925M of revenue, but at {cap} the market pays for roughly three times our modelled sales in a crowded anti-CD20 MS market.
TGTX.th_cat: Subcutaneous BRIUMVI Ph3 topline (around YE2026 or early 2027). We would cover if SC data show quarterly dosing with ocrelizumab-class relapse control and guidance rises again.

ERAS.th_view: Short on valuation: ERAS-0015 has unconfirmed Ph1 responses (62% in 37 NSCLC patients) but the company is worth {cap} while RevMed already has randomized Ph3 survival data.
ERAS.th_cat: ERAS-0015 updates and ERAS-4001 monotherapy data (2H26). We would cover if confirmed responses hold above ~50% with durability that matches daraxonrasib.

PBLS.th_view: Short on valuation: zolucatetide's 72% response rate in desmoids is real, but it comes from 18 patients in a small indication and the company is worth {cap}.
PBLS.th_cat: Mature desmoid data and FDA Ph3 alignment (Q4 2026). We would cover if activity in a larger Wnt-driven tumor (colorectal, liver) appears.

KRSA.th_view: Strong short: a preclinical Alzheimer's antibody with no human data, valued at {cap}.
KRSA.th_cat: Ph1 healthy-volunteer data (mid-2027). We would cover if brain exposure is several times lecanemab's with no ARIA signal.

DMRA.th_view: Short: DMR-001 has no human data until mid-2027, yet the company is worth {cap}.
DMRA.th_cat: CLARITY-101 first-in-human data (mid-2027). We would cover if early patients show platelet control plus falling mutant-CALR allele burden.

COAG.th_view: Short: HMB-002 has one interim signal (>50% fewer treated bleeds) in von Willebrand disease, and the company is worth {cap}.
COAG.th_cat: HMB-002 Ph1/2 bleed data and SOLARA Ph3 run-in (Q4 2026). We would cover if annualized bleed rates fall to IV-concentrate levels (~2-4) with monthly SC dosing.

TRAX.th_view: Strong short: one positive gluten-challenge cohort (villus:crypt +0.49 vs placebo) supports a {cap} valuation, and a same-mechanism competitor is about a year ahead.
TRAX.th_cat: Cohort 2 mucosal-healing topline (Q1 2027). We would cover if Cohort 2 confirms histologic protection with a larger effect.

NBTX.th_view: Short: the Ph3 asset has only Ph1 survival data (23 vs ~12 months, historical), and J&J economics leave a small peak (~$150M to Nanobiotix) against a {cap} cap.
NBTX.th_cat: NANORAY-312 Ph3 progress after the protocol amendment (2027). We would cover if J&J expands NBTXR3 into lung cancer with positive CONVERGE data.

JBIO.th_view: Short: JADE101 has only healthy-volunteer IgA data, while atacicept was approved in IgA nephropathy in July; the company is worth {cap}.
JBIO.th_cat: EVERGREEN Ph3 start (Q4 2026) and first patient data (2027). We would cover if patient proteinuria cuts beat sibeprenlimab's ~50% with dosing every 12 weeks.

AVLN.th_view: Short: inhaled pirfenidone has no randomized data until 2H 2027 and must beat cheap generic oral pirfenidone; the company is worth {cap}.
AVLN.th_cat: MIST Ph2b 52-week FVC topline (2H 2027). We would cover if FVC decline is clearly smaller than with oral pirfenidone, with fewer GI side effects.

DRTS.th_view: Strong short: Alpha DaRT has no pivotal efficacy data yet and the company is worth {cap} against a small skin-cancer niche.
DRTS.th_cat: ReSTART cSCC pivotal topline (late 2026 to early 2027). We would cover on a local response rate well above cemiplimab's ~47% with durable control.

AKTS.th_view: Short: AKY-1189 has no efficacy data until 1Q27, and the company trades well above its {cash} of cash.
AKTS.th_cat: AKY-1189 preliminary Ph1b data (Q1 2027). We would cover if responses approach enfortumab vedotin's ~52% with manageable kidney and marrow toxicity.

STTK.th_view: Strong short: SL-325 has no efficacy data until 2028, about two years behind Merck's tulisokibart in the same TL1A pathway.
STTK.th_cat: RECEPTIVE-CD1 Ph2b data (1H 2028). We would cover if a partner pays for SL-325 before data, which would validate the DR3 approach.

BBTX.th_view: Strong short: a fresh IPO valued at {cap} on small IV data (week-6 EASI-75 64%) in a field Dupixent dominates.
BBTX.th_cat: 12-week SC proof-of-concept in AD (1H 2027). We would cover if SC dosing every quarter keeps EASI-75 above 50% without conjunctivitis.

ATTO.th_view: Short: ATTO-1310's Ph1b itch data are encouraging (PP-NRS4 82% vs 22%), but the company is worth {cap} in a field led by nemolizumab and dupilumab.
ATTO.th_cat: Full Ph1 data (YE2026); Ph2 starts (1H 2027). We would cover if Ph2 shows dosing every 3-6 months with itch relief beyond nemolizumab.

CBIO.th_view: Short: CR-001 is a PD-1×VEGF bispecific with no human data, chasing ivonescimab, which itself just received a CRL.
CBIO.th_cat: ASCEND Ph1/2 proof-of-concept data (Q1 2027). We would cover if early responses are competitive with ivonescimab's and a partner signs.

DSGN.th_view: Short: DT-216P2's 4-week frataxin rise (+65% mRNA) and small mFARS change come from ~20 patients, which does not support a {cap} value.
DSGN.th_cat: 12-week RESTORE-FA durability data and registrational-path update (Q4 2026). We would cover if frataxin gains hold and mFARS improves versus natural history.

CGEM.th_view: Short: CLN-978's lupus and RA signals are early (71% hSLEDAI response in 14 SLE patients) and the company is worth well above its {cash} of cash.
CGEM.th_cat: CLN-978 multi-dose data (Dec 2026 webcast); zipalertinib PDUFA Feb 27 2027. We would cover on approval of zipalertinib plus durable drug-free remissions with CLN-978.

ACRS.th_view: Short: bosakitug missed its Ph2 in AD on Nov 16, leaving value on ATI-052, which has only Ph1b data.
ACRS.th_cat: ATI-052 Ph2b start in eosinophilic esophagitis (Q1 2027). We would cover if a partner funds ATI-052 or Ph2b data match dupilumab.

ANL.th_view: Short: AN9025 has no clinical data, ex-China rights only, and a {cap} cap against a pan-RAS field led by RevMed.
ANL.th_cat: Initial Ph1a data (1H 2027). We would cover if early responses in pancreatic cancer match daraxonrasib's.

OVID.th_view: Short: OV329 has target-engagement data in healthy volunteers but no seizure efficacy, and the company is worth {cap}.
OVID.th_cat: Photosensitivity study topline (Q1 2027). We would cover if OV329 cuts photoparoxysmal responses in most patients without vision effects.

EPRX.th_view: Short: EP-104GI's open-label EoE data (66.7% remission at 12 months in cohort 5) still lack a placebo comparison, and that readout slipped to Q4 2026.
EPRX.th_cat: RESOLVE Ph2b placebo-controlled topline (Q4 2026). We would cover if histologic remission beats placebo by 40 points or more after one injection.

DMAC.th_view: Strong short: DM199 has no efficacy data in stroke, a field with almost no Ph3 successes, and only {cash} of cash.
DMAC.th_cat: ReMEDy2 interim analysis (Q1 2027). We would cover if the DSMB recommends continuing without a sample-size increase.

PHAT.th_view: Long: VOQUEZNA is approved in erosive and non-erosive GERD (92.9% healing vs 84.6% for lansoprazole) with $339M of annualized sales, yet the company is worth {cap}.
PHAT.th_cat: EoE Ph2 topline and FDA exclusivity decision (Q4 2026). We would cut if exclusivity is lost early or quarterly sales growth stalls.

CADL.th_view: Long: CAN-2409 cut prostate cancer recurrence or death by 30% (HR 0.70) in a 745-patient randomized Ph3, and the company is worth {cap}.
CADL.th_cat: BLA submission (mid-2027, after FDA dialogue on the assay). We would cut if FDA requires a new trial or the BLA slips past 2027.

ATYR.th_view: Strong short: efzofitimod missed its Ph3 primary endpoint (p=0.33), and a new Ph3 needs funding the company does not have ({cash} of cash).
ATYR.th_cat: Global Ph3 start or a funding partner (2027). We would cover if a partner funds the FVC-primary Ph3.

AVTX.th_view: Long: abdakibart met its HS Ph2 primary endpoint (HiSCR75 ~42% vs 25.6% placebo) and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
AVTX.th_cat: FDA feedback on the Ph3 plan (YE2026). We would cut if FDA asks for a larger program than the cash can fund.

ALEC.th_view: Short: after two failed programs, Alector's value rests on a preclinical brain-carrier platform and AL137, whose IND slipped to Q1 2027.
ALEC.th_cat: AL137 IND and first dosing (by Apr 2027). We would cover if a partner pays meaningfully for the brain-carrier platform.

CAMP.th_view: Short: CMP-002 has only mouse seizure data for SYNGAP1 and the company is worth well above its {cash} of cash.
CAMP.th_cat: ASCEND Ph1/2 first patient dosed (YE2026). We would cover on early human biomarker evidence of SYNGAP1 protein increase.

CCCC.th_view: Long: cemsidomide showed a 53% response rate at the Ph2 dose in heavily pretreated myeloma, and the company trades near its {cash} of cash.
CCCC.th_cat: Cemsidomide and elranatamab combination update. We would cut if responses fall below ~35% in larger cohorts or neutropenia limits dosing.

TRXB.th_view: Short: TRB-061 has only healthy-volunteer data in AD, a market with many approved biologics and orals.
TRXB.th_cat: Ph1b AD topline (mid-2027). We would cover if patients show EASI improvement with durable Treg expansion.

PROK.th_view: Long: rilparencel slowed eGFR decline by 4.6 mL/min/yr (78%) in Ph2, and the Ph3 accelerated-approval cohort uses an FDA-agreed surrogate endpoint.
PROK.th_cat: PROACT-1 Ph3 eGFR-slope topline (1H 2027). We would cut if the eGFR-slope benefit falls below ~2 mL/min/yr.

IAM.th_view: Short: IAM1363's 36% response rate comes from a Ph1 basket while zongertinib (approved, ~70% ORR) and T-DXd set the HER2 bar.
IAM.th_cat: Registrational breast cancer study start (2027). We would cover if brain-metastasis responses (41% so far) hold in a larger cohort, a niche the competitors serve poorly.

SLBT.th_view: Strong short: the cell-therapy pipeline is preclinical with no IND, and cash is {cash}.
SLBT.th_cat: CD19 Armed-T IND (Q1 2027). We would cover on an IND clearance plus financing.

QTTB.th_view: Long: bempikibart cut SALT scores 35% in open-label alopecia data with responses holding off-drug, and the company trades near its {cash} of cash.
QTTB.th_cat: Week-52 follow-up and FDA discussions (Q4 2026). We would cut if off-drug responses fade or FDA requires two new Ph3s.

WHWK.th_view: Short: HWK-007 has no human data, and an earlier PTK7 ADC (cofetuzumab pelidotin) was discontinued.
WHWK.th_cat: HWK-007 Ph1 data (1H 2027). We would cover if early responses appear in NSCLC or ovarian cancer at tolerable doses.

GLSI.th_view: Short: the HER2 vaccine's case rests on a small Ph2 (100% vs 89.4% 5-year invasion-free survival), cash is {cash}, and the company has a Nasdaq notice.
GLSI.th_cat: FLAMINGO-01 first interim at 28 events (undated). We would cover on a clean interim with funding secured.

ADCT.th_view: Strong short: FDA raised concerns about more deaths on drug in LOTIS-5 with no survival gain, and the company carries $420M of debt against a {cap} cap.
ADCT.th_cat: LOTIS-5 full data and LOTIS-7 update at ASH (Dec 2026). We would cover if LOTIS-7 with glofitamab supports a new label path.

ALT.th_view: Long: pemvidutide has Breakthrough designation and the company trades below its {cash} of cash, though the 24-week fibrosis biopsy endpoint missed.
ALT.th_cat: FDA end-of-Ph2 meeting for alcohol use disorder (Dec 2026). We would cut if FDA does not accept non-invasive fibrosis measures for Ph3.

KYTX.th_view: Long: miv-cel is the first CAR-T with a significant registrational result in stiff-person syndrome (49% median walking-speed gain, 92% off immunotherapy at one year).
KYTX.th_cat: Rolling BLA completion (Q4 2026). We would cut if the BLA slips or FDA requests a randomized trial.

AGMB.th_view: Long: ontunisertib targets strictures in Crohn's disease, which have no approved drug, and the company trades near its {cash} of cash.
AGMB.th_cat: NOV-ERA Ph2b start and STENOVA extension data (YE2026). We would cut if gut-restricted exposure fails to show fibrosis biomarker change.

VCRE.th_view: Long: buloxibutid improved FVC by 23 mL vs a 115 mL decline in external controls over 36 weeks in IPF, a rare improvement signal.
VCRE.th_cat: ASPIRE Ph2b futility analysis (Q4 2026); 52-week topline (mid-2027). We would cut if futility triggers or placebo-controlled FVC benefit is under 50 mL.

OCGN.th_view: Long: OCU400 is a gene-agnostic retinitis pigmentosa therapy with completed Ph3 enrollment, against a {cap} cap.
OCGN.th_cat: liMeliGhT Ph3 topline (Q1 2027). We would cut if the low-luminance visual acuity gain misses, which would end the program.

EBS.th_view: Long on valuation, low conviction: Q3 revenue fell 52% as OTC NARCAN sales dropped, but at {cap} plus net debt the company trades at a low multiple of guided EBITDA.
EBS.th_cat: Q4 results and 2027 guidance; interim CFO from Jan 1 2027. We would exit if NARCAN declines continue and EBITDA guidance is cut.

TTRX.th_view: Strong short: GX-03's topical AD trial was redesigned with four endpoints and a broader population, raising the bar, and cash is {cash}.
TTRX.th_cat: Stage-2 topline (Q4 2026 to Q1 2027). We would cover on a clean win on vIGA and EASI-75 against vehicle.

PLX.th_view: Short: the gout optionality (PRX-115, Ph2 in 2027) is priced in, while value today rests on Elfabrio royalties.
PLX.th_cat: PRX-115 Ph2 data (2027). We would cover if PRX-115 shows urate control with less immunogenicity than pegloticase.

AUTL.th_view: Long: AUCATZYL is approved in adult B-ALL with ~0% severe CRS, and early lupus data (83% DORIS remission in 6 patients) add an autoimmune option.
AUTL.th_cat: AUCATZYL launch update and ALARIC data at ASH (Dec 2026). We would cut if launch sales stall, given $360M of debt.

ANTX.th_view: Short: epetraborole's polycythemia vera pivot has no human data and lags rusfertide (77% responders).
ANTX.th_cat: Ph2 PV first data (YE2026). We would cover if oral dosing controls hematocrit without phlebotomy in most patients.

CUVL.th_view: Long: SCENESSE is the only approved EPP therapy and profitable, and cash of {cash} covers most of the {cap} cap.
CUVL.th_cat: CUV105 vitiligo Ph3 topline (Dec 2026). We would cut on a vitiligo miss only if core EPP sales also slow.

DTIL.th_view: Short: PBGENE-HBV has paired-biopsy evidence of cccDNA editing in 16 patients, but durable HBsAg loss is unproven.
DTIL.th_cat: Ph2 dose selection and PBGENE-DMD safety data (YE2026). We would cover on sustained HBsAg loss off therapy in several patients.

PYXS.th_view: Strong short: MICVO's monotherapy response rate fell from 46% to 36% as the head and neck cohort grew to 33, and cash is {cash}.
PYXS.th_cat: First-line MICVO plus pembrolizumab data (Dec 2026). We would cover if the combination holds ~70% responses in 20+ patients.

RNAC.th_view: Long: Descartes-08 is an outpatient mRNA CAR-T in myasthenia gravis with a 6.6-point MG-ADL reduction at 12 months after retreatment and an SPA-locked Ph3.
RNAC.th_cat: AURORA Ph3 topline (Q1 2027). We would cut if the placebo-adjusted MG-ADL benefit is under 2 points.

ACOG.th_view: Long, low conviction: ZUNVEYL sales grew 30% to ~$7.8M in Q3, but this is a better-tolerated galantamine against generic donepezil, so the upside is modest.
ACOG.th_cat: CONVERGE real-world data (Dec 2026) and quarterly sales. We would exit if quarterly growth falls below 15%.

BIOA.th_view: Long: BGE-102, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor, cut hsCRP ≥85% in Ph1, and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
BIOA.th_cat: QUELL-CV Ph2 12-week hsCRP topline (Q4 2026). We would cut if the hsCRP reduction falls below ~60% in patients.

LCTX.th_view: Strong short: OpRegen's vision gains (+6.2 letters) come from 5 uncontrolled patients, and cash is {cash}.
LCTX.th_cat: OpRegen Ph2 GA data from Roche. We would cover if Roche expands the program on controlled data.

ARTV.th_view: Long as a liquidation: the lead was discontinued Oct 27 and a strategic review includes liquidation, but cash of {cash} exceeds the {cap} cap.
ARTV.th_cat: Strategic review outcome. We would exit if management spends the cash on a new pipeline rather than returning it.
ARTV.th_miss: With the lead discontinued, value is cash less wind-down costs; the {cap} cap is below {cash} of cash.

VTVT.th_view: Long: cadisegliatin, an oral adjunct for type 1 diabetes with Breakthrough designation, halved hypoglycemic events in Ph2 (p=0.0017).
VTVT.th_cat: CATT1 Ph3 topline (mid-2027). We would cut if level 2/3 hypoglycemia is not reduced versus placebo.
VTVT.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because Ph2 halved hypoglycemia and the mechanism is liver-selective.

ANIK.th_view: Long: Cingal beat triamcinolone in a Ph3 for knee osteoarthritis pain, while the core HA business grows 6-10%.
ANIK.th_cat: Cingal US regulatory path (NDA by end-2027). We would cut if FDA requires another trial for Cingal.

CABA.th_view: Long: rese-cel showed 83% drug-free responses in myositis in early data, and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
CABA.th_cat: RESET-Myositis registrational topline (2H 2027). We would cut if drug-free response durability falls below 50%.

NERV.th_view: Long: roluperidone targets negative symptoms of schizophrenia, which have no approved drug, against a {cap} cap.
NERV.th_cat: MIN-101C19 confirmatory Ph3 Part A (2H 2027). We would cut if the confirmatory trial misses PANSS negative-symptom separation.

ABEO.th_view: Long: ZEVASKYN is approved for RDEB wounds (81% vs 16% healing) and its launch is ahead of plan, against a {cap} cap.
ABEO.th_cat: Q4 sales and treatment-center growth. We would cut if quarterly revenue stalls.

VRXA.th_view: Strong short: VXA-102 is preclinical (IND ~2028) and cash is {cash}.
VRXA.th_cat: Partnering of VXA-901 (2027). We would cover on a funded partnership.

STRO.th_view: Strong short: STRO-004 has no disclosed response rates and net debt (cash $142M, debt $249M) leaves equity with little backing.
STRO.th_cat: STRIVE-01 data update (1H 2027). We would cover on disclosed response rates above ~30% in a defined tumor type.

ZNTL.th_view: Long: azenosertib doubled overall survival in Cyclin E1+ ovarian cancer (15.9 vs 7.5 months, cross-cohort), and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
ZNTL.th_cat: DENALI Part 2 registration-intent topline (1H 2027). We would cut if response rate falls below ~30%, given relacorilant's approval.

GUTS.th_view: Long: Revita met its Ph3 co-primary (patients kept ~80% of GLP-1 weight loss vs 67% with sham), against a {cap} cap.
GUTS.th_cat: De Novo submission (late Q4 2026). We would cut if the submission slips, given runway into Q2 2027.

PYPD.th_view: Long into the PDUFA: D-PLEX100 cut surgical-site infections 60% (p=0.0013) in Ph3.
PYPD.th_cat: FDA decision (Nov 28 2026). We would cut on a CRL or if no US commercial partner is signed.

CMPX.th_view: Long: tovecimig beat paclitaxel in second-line biliary cancer (PFS HR 0.44) and the company trades below its {cash} of cash, though FDA wants an OS trial.
CMPX.th_cat: FDA engagement on the BLA path. We would cut if Compass commits to a costly OS trial without a partner.

HUMA.th_view: Long: ATEV beat fistula on catheter-free days (220 vs 129) in women on dialysis, and a dialysis sBLA would open a much larger market than trauma.
HUMA.th_cat: Dialysis-access sBLA filing (late 2026). We would cut if trauma sales stay near today's ~$4M/yr after the filing.

ELOX.th_view: Short: exaluren has biopsy data from 3 Alport patients, and the company's cash is {cash}.
ELOX.th_cat: EXACT Ph2b 16-week topline (mid-2027). We would cover on significant slit-density improvement versus placebo.

EQ.th_view: Short: EQ504 is preclinical and the company's value is not backed by data.
EQ.th_cat: EQ504 Ph1 proof-of-mechanism data (mid-2027). We would cover on clear IL-22 target engagement.

ARMP.th_view: Strong short: Armata carries $222M of debt against {cash} of cash, so equity has little backing even if the phage Ph3 succeeds.
ARMP.th_cat: Ph3 start (late 2026). We would cover if Innoviva converts debt to equity and funds the Ph3.

SPRB.th_view: Long: TA-ERT showed six years of CSF heparan-sulfate normalization and stable cognition in Sanfilippo B, and the BLA delay is manufacturing, not data.
SPRB.th_cat: BLA submission (Dec 2026). We would cut if the BLA slips again.

MENS.th_view: Strong short: the US pivotal trial of MCS-2 failed, the NDA is guided to 2029-2030, and cash is {cash}.
MENS.th_cat: Strategy update. We would cover only on new approvable data.

GNLX.th_view: Short: Olvi-Vec's Ph3 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer is a binary readout with {cash} of cash.
GNLX.th_cat: OnPrime Ph3 topline (YE2026). We would cover if PFS clearly beats chemotherapy plus bevacizumab (~3.8 months).

VANI.th_view: Strong short: SLIM-1 showed weight loss equal to low-dose Wegovy (0.79% vs 0.82% at 4 weeks) in 10 patients per arm, and cash is {cash}.
VANI.th_cat: SLIM-1 topline (Nov 2026) and Novo evaluation. We would cover if Novo exercises its option.

LENZ.th_view: Long as cash value: VIZZ beat VUITY on near-vision response but sold only $2.6M in Q3; the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
LENZ.th_cat: Interim CEO from Dec 1 and reorganization. We would exit if cash burn continues without a sales inflection.

DERM.th_view: Long: Q3 revenue was $19.0M (+8%) with Emrosi beating Oracea head to head, against a {cap} cap.
DERM.th_cat: Quarterly Emrosi growth. We would cut if Emrosi growth stalls.

UPB.th_view: Long: verekitug cut asthma exacerbations 56% vs placebo (p<0.001) with dosing every 12 weeks, and the company trades well below its {cash} of cash.
UPB.th_cat: End-of-Ph2 meetings and Ph3 starts (Q1 2027). We would cut if Ph3 cannot be funded without heavy dilution.

RTSN.th_view: Strong short: RTN-001 has a 40-patient crossover study with undisclosed blood-pressure magnitudes and {cash} of cash.
RTSN.th_cat: Ph2b dose-ranging data (1H 2027). We would cover if placebo-adjusted SBP falls 8 mmHg or more.

NTHI.th_view: Strong short: NEO100 has a 24-patient single-arm glioma study and {cash} of cash.
NTHI.th_cat: FDA end-of-phase meetings (Nov 2026). We would cover if FDA agrees to an accelerated-approval path on the current data.

ANIX.th_view: Strong short: lira-cel has no confirmed RECIST responses after 14 patients over 4 years, and cash is {cash}.
ANIX.th_cat: Further lira-cel dose cohorts. We would cover on confirmed responses.

HURA.th_view: Strong short: IFx-2.0 has no efficacy data and cash is {cash}.
HURA.th_cat: IFx-2.0 Ph1b/2a MCC data. We would cover if responses clearly exceed pembrolizumab's 56%.

IPHA.th_view: Strong short: lacutamab roughly matches mogamulizumab in Sézary syndrome (ORR 43% vs 37%), a small market, and cash is {cash}.
IPHA.th_cat: AstraZeneca's PACIFIC-9 readout (monalizumab). We would cover on a positive PACIFIC-9.

KZIA.th_view: Short: paxalisib missed in glioblastoma, and the TNBC signal comes from 6 patients.
KZIA.th_cat: TNBC Ph1b expansion (early 2027). We would cover if responses hold in the expanded cohort.

RANI.th_view: Short: the RaniPill has bioavailability data but no weight-loss data, and cash is {cash}.
RANI.th_cat: RT-114 Ph1b repeat-dose data (2027). We would cover on weight loss near injected GLP-1s.

PLYX.th_view: Strong short: PLX-200 has no clinical efficacy data and cash is {cash}.
PLYX.th_cat: SOTERIA first patient dosed (Q4 2026). We would cover on funded progress to a readout.

PMVP.th_view: Long: rezatapopt achieved a 46% response rate in TP53 Y220C ovarian cancer (n=76) with an NDA due Q1 2027, and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
PMVP.th_cat: NDA submission (Q1 2027). We would cut if FDA requires a randomized trial before approval.

CING.th_view: Long: CTx-1301 met its Ph3 endpoints and its CRL was manufacturing only, against a {cap} cap.
CING.th_cat: NDA resubmission (Dec 2026 to Jan 2027). We would cut if the resubmission slips or cash runs out first ({cash}).
CING.th_miss: At {cap} the market implies ~{imp} odds; we use {ours} because the CRL cited manufacturing only, with efficacy endpoints met.

ATRA.th_view: Short: tab-cel has a PDUFA on Mar 31 2027, but the company has {cash} of cash and $41M of debt, so value may go to new money.
ATRA.th_cat: PDUFA Mar 31 2027. We would cover on approval with non-dilutive funding.

MNOV.th_view: Short: ibudilast in ALS is a non-specific mechanism with a binary Ph2b topline.
MNOV.th_cat: COMBAT-ALS topline (YE2026). We would cover on a 25%+ slowing of ALSFRS-R decline.

FBIO.th_view: Long: the company trades below its net cash after the $205M PRV sale, with ZYCUBO approved in Menkes disease.
FBIO.th_cat: Holding-company actions. We would exit if cash is spent on new subsidiaries.

NTRB.th_view: Strong short: AVERSA has no human abuse-potential data, and cash is {cash}.
NTRB.th_cat: HAP study start (2027). We would cover on funded HAP progress.

VRCA.th_view: Long: VP-315 cleared basal cell carcinoma completely in some patients (3 of 14 histologic clearance), and YCANTH supports revenue.
VRCA.th_cat: VP-315 Ph3 design and funding decision. We would cut if funding requires heavy dilution.

CGTX.th_view: Short: zervimesine's DLB signal was exploratory (p=0.0545) and the Ph3 depends on funding.
CGTX.th_cat: Ph3 start (mid-2027). We would cover on a funding partner for Ph3.

CNXU.th_view: Strong short: CXU is a device with no 510(k) filed and cash of {cash}.
CNXU.th_cat: 510(k) submission (Q1 2027). We would cover on clearance.

LGVN.th_view: Strong short: ELPIS II missed its primary endpoint and FDA rejected the endpoint; cash is {cash}.
LGVN.th_cat: FDA meeting and strategic review. We would cover on a sale or funded path.

MIST.th_view: Long: CARDAMYST is approved for PSVT (64% vs 31% conversion) and cash of {cash} roughly matches debt, against a {cap} cap.
MIST.th_cat: Launch metrics and cost cuts (Q1 2027). We would cut if scripts stay flat after formulary wins.

ACRV.th_view: Long: ACR-368 shows 39% responses in biomarker-positive endometrial cancer and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
ACRV.th_cat: Arms 3+4 interim and Arm 1 update (Q4 2026). We would cut if responses in the serous arms fall below ~30%.
ACRV.th_miss: At {cap}, below cash, the market gives ACR-368 no value; we use {ours} odds because biomarker-selected responses (39%) are about twice the ~15-20% standard of care.

HRTX.th_view: Long as a deal spread: Heron agreed to sell its assets to CorMedix (Nov 9), with value to holders depending on debt payoff and costs.
HRTX.th_cat: Stockholder vote and close (Q1 2027). We would exit if the deal is cut or HSR delays push the close past mid-2027.
HRTX.th_miss: Value depends on the CorMedix price net of $126M of debt and deal costs.

SPRO.th_view: Long as cash and royalties: UTEBZI is approved and partnered with GSK (up to $351M of milestones), and the company trades near its net cash.
SPRO.th_cat: UTEBZI launch milestones and SP001 Ph2 start (Q2 2027). We would cut if launch milestones slip.
SPRO.th_miss: At {cap}, the market prices Spero at about net cash and ignores the 35% residual interest in UTEBZI milestones and royalties from GSK.
